text_ru: Недобор работников при этом наряде: «{work}» −{count} (оценка на сегодня).
meaning: Estimated worker shortfall by job kind if the draft day order stands, using today’s preview
intent: Report the consequence of the typed order as a dated estimate before commitment; no advice
keep: Keep conditional draft context and estimate qualifier; count workers, not carts or horses; no fabricated accountant appointment, order issue or guaranteed tomorrow result
binding_note: game-rpg-1778-preview-line-2026-11-17 [1]; society.md first-build self-placement, boss 17 Nov / econ #1811; PreviewDayOrder core #1825. work is the existing localized Notebook job label in citation form, inserted unchanged inside quotes, not a raw key. count is the owner-provided positive integer shortfall from the preview of placement with/without the draft; no desired/assigned count substituted. CSV supplies the minus sign: pass a positive count without a sign or noun. One line per affected job kind; preview issues no order. No extra hauling key or plural formatter required.
